card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: Middle or ending pieces of longer words in drug labels, such as symptom|atically, subcut|aneously, syst|olic, and im|ipenem. It also fires on a few abbreviations like IP.

modes.label: Adverb endings
modes.description: The ending piece of a long medical adverb or adjective, after its stem is already written.
modes.example: treat symptom<<atically>>, and institute general supportive treatment.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: The middle piece of a split drug name such as imipenem or imiglucerase.

modes.label: Route abbreviations
modes.description: A short route-of-administration abbreviation in parentheses.
